modelInfo.rawText: {"diagnosis":"The fixed Add to Cart button is occluded by the fixed sticky-promo bar, making it unclickable at all viewports.","evidenceSummary":"Probes at mobile, small, and desktop show add-to-cart in viewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement sticky-promo; screenshot shows only the bottom promo bar and no visible button; styles.css places add-to-cart at bottom:16px with z-index:10 while sticky-promo is bottom:0, height:84px, z-index:20.","file":"styles.css","old":"bottom: 16px;","new":"bottom: 100px;","rationale":"Moving the button to 100px from the bottom clears the 84px promo plus a 16px gap, preserving both elements while making the button hit-testable."}

response.diagnosis: The fixed Add to Cart button is occluded by the fixed sticky-promo bar, making it unclickable at all viewports.
response.evidenceSummary: Probes at mobile, small, and desktop show add-to-cart in viewport but hitIsSelf=false with hitElement sticky-promo; screenshot shows only the bottom promo bar and no visible button; styles.css places add-to-cart at bottom:16px with z-index:10 while sticky-promo is bottom:0, height:84px, z-index:20.
response.rationale: Moving the button to 100px from the bottom clears the 84px promo plus a 16px gap, preserving both elements while making the button hit-testable.
